verdict.rationale: New Relic AI is documented as a plain-language assistant for querying and troubleshooting telemetry data (docs-9, docs-10) and hints at moving 'beyond assistance to automated remediation' (docs-38), which implies some incident-context AI support, but there is no explicit documentation of AI-generated incident summaries or alert-context briefings specifically for responders. Missing for 10: dedicated incident-summary feature docs, evidence of alert-context generation for on-call responders, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific capability.
